blocks.text: I haven't hit a ball yet. Tomorrow will be the first time. In the end, it is about how I feel, and we'll see how things go. I don't want to take anything for granted, but what I can say is that I feel a little better every day and I can see more clearly that I'm recovering. blocks.label: on playing too many tournaments
blocks.text: I probably could have done things differently. I'm not going to lie. Pushing yourself to play every week, eventually you're killing yourself. But I think it is what it is. From now on, I will learn and I will do things a little bit differently. I think everybody is going to be like that.

blocks.text: Over the past few months, together with my team, we've tried everything to treat my injury without surgery. After some very encouraging progress early on, my knee unfortunately didn't respond as we had all hoped, that's why today I underwent a minor surgery to improve the condition of my iliotibial band.
